_comment: Owner-only /finops summary (FinOps design finops-cost-tracking-design-2026-11-16 §5, §13; tracker S2-83 release 4). Read by utils/finops.js. Project ids come from the environment (FINOPS_PROJECT, USAGE_PROJECT; no defaults). The four views and their logic (month, forecast, freshness) belong to finops-admin (finops-admin/docs/how-it-works.md); this file only names them. The query runs in FINOPS_PROJECT as cortex-gateway@ (READER on view_dataset + jobUser there; READER on usage_dataset here).

pause.paused_message: Cortex-Drive is paused by the owner. Questions and new sources are unavailable until it is resumed.
pause._comment: Release 5: the owner's manual pause of usage-based (OpenAI) spend. Source of truth: app_settings (migration 012); Redis mirror read by every service. If Redis cannot be read, services continue (fail open) and log a warning: the pause is a cost control, not a security boundary.
